name: claude-profile
description: Sync ~/.claude profiles across devices. Use /profile to manage profiles.

arguments.name: subcommand
arguments.description: The subcommand to run (list, switch, push, pull, new, delete, status, base, migrate)

arguments.name: args
arguments.description: Additional arguments for the subcommand (e.g. profile name for switch/new/delete, 'add <relpath>' for base, '--all --dry-run' for migrate)
